title: Service Plan
description: Describes a single subscription tier of a service and the privacy / security commitments associated with it. Many services apply different terms to different plans, so each plan is captured separately.

plan_name.description: Slug identifying the plan within the service. Should match the filename (without .json).

display_name.description: Human-readable plan name as marketed by the vendor (e.g. 'Professional').

target_user.description: Primary intended audience for the plan.

conditions.description: Plan-specific privacy and security conditions. Use 'unspecified' or null when the vendor has not published a clear answer.

ai_training.description: Whether customer content may be used to train the vendor's (or third-party) AI models on this plan.

data_residency_choice.description: Whether customers on this plan can choose where their data is stored.

dpa_available.description: Whether a Data Processing Addendum can be executed on this plan.

sso_available.description: Whether SAML / OIDC single sign-on is included or available.

audit_log_retention_days.description: How many days of audit logs are retained. null = not offered or unknown.

deletion_grace_period_days.description: Days between account deletion request and irreversible erasure. null = unknown.

notes.description: Free-form human notes about the plan, Markdown allowed.

source_urls.description: Primary sources (vendor pages, blog posts, ToS sections) that back the conditions above.
